_comment: Shared artist enrichment cache — name-keyed, key = artist name trimmed and lowercased. Fields per entry: mbid (MusicBrainz artist id), genres (raw lowercase tag strings, cap 8, NOT canonicalized here — canonicalization happens client-side via data/genres.json), soundcloudSlug, spotifyId, youtubeQuery, youtubeVideoIds (cached YouTube video ids, cap 4, first = auto-pick), bandsintownId (stored, unused in v1), enrichedAt (ISO timestamp of the last enrichment write). The festival entry in data/festivals/<id>.json artists[] is always the reference; this cache exists so an artist already researched for one festival is never re-researched for another. Populated by scripts/enrich-artists.mjs (node scripts/enrich-artists.mjs <festival-id>), which never overwrites a non-empty value already present here or in a festival entry — enrichment fills gaps only, so hand-edits to either file always win.
